name: TurfFlow — Post-Match Player Feedback WhatsApp Cron

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "messaging_product": "whatsapp",
  "recipient_type": "individual",
  "to": "{{ $json.customerPhone.replace('+', '') }}",
  "type": "text",
  "text": {
    "body": "⭐ *HOW WAS YOUR MATCH?* ⭐
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Hey " + $json.customerName + "! Hope your game on " + $json.courtName + " was thrilling!

How would you rate your pitch & lighting experience today?

⭐ 5 - Excellent
⭐ 4 - Good
⭐ 3 - Average
⭐ 1-2 - Needs Improvement

Reply with your rating number or any feedback! As a thank you, use code *TURFPLAY10* for 10% off your next match. 🏆"
  }
}
